C:P2.3.text: A REIT with a Focused Approach

C:P2.4.text: Orion Properties specializes in the ownership, acquisition and management of a diversified portfolio of high-quality properties across the U.S. The portfolio is primarily leased on a single-tenant net lease basis to creditworthy tenants and includes traditional office buildings as well as dedicated use assets, such as government, medical office, flex/lab, R&D, and flex/industrial assets.

C:P2.5.text: The company’s team of experienced industry leaders employs a proven, cycle-tested investment evaluation framework which serves as the lens through which capital allocation decisions are made for the current portfolio and future acquisitions.

C:P2.6.text: Orion utilizes its investment evaluation framework to pursue a value creation strategy.

C:P2.7.text: With conservative leverage and strong liquidity, the company can both invest in our existing portfolio and opportunistically take advantage of opportunities to acquire high-quality dedicated use assets that have an office component.

C:P2.8.text: Sustainability initiatives are critical to our success. The company is focused on actions in coordination with tenants that are designed to have a long-term, positive impact on all stakeholders.

C:P2.9.text: The portfolio comprises of 57 properties totaling approximately 6.4 million total leasable square feet located within 26 states.

C:P2.10.text: An Experienced and Knowledgeable Executive Team

C:P2.11.text: With over 100 years of collective experience, the Orion management team has extensive knowledge of the single-tenant real estate sector, including operations, leasing, acquisitions, development and disposition of assets through all stages of the real estate cycle. This team has in-depth market experience, long-standing relationships with local, regional and national industry participants, and a proven track record of execution.

T:P2.10.text: Through our family of REITs, we provide access to diversified commercial real estate strategies across office, retail, senior living and healthcare and net lease sectors. Our REITs combine long-term ownership, disciplined capital allocation and operational excellence supported by our national platform.

T:P2.6.text: Our roots run deep in real estate, but our vision is forward-looking. Today, RMR manages a diverse platform of REITs, a growing private capital business anchored by multifamily and commercial real estate lending and a nationwide operating infrastructure that gives us reach, insight and speed few can match.

T:P2.5.text: RMR is a leading U.S. real estate investment manager with more than four decades of experience creating value across commercial real estate, private capital and credit strategies.

T:P2.11.text: RMR offers a growing suite of private investment strategies designed for today’s evolving real estate landscape, including:

T:P2.17.text: Our vertically integrated platform is where potential becomes tangible. By uniting leasing, engineering and essential support services – including IT, recruiting and marketing – with core capabilities in acquisition, development, financing and operations, we deliver a holistic approach to asset management.
